mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase propafenone's risk of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly; maintain potassium >3.5 mEq/L and magnesium >2.0 mg/dL; consider potassium-sparing agent or increased dietary supplementation.
